toolDefinitions.name: list_pricing_data
toolDefinitions.description: Discover local product IDs/names and available channel rule IDs with provenance. Choose only a matching record; clarify ambiguity.

toolDefinitions.name: get_product
toolDefinitions.description: Read product costs (BRL, grams, hours, kW) and provenance. Null is unknown.

toolDefinitions.name: get_channel_rule
toolDefinitions.description: Read separate revenue charge rates, fixed fee, source and validity. No Shopee rules exist.

toolDefinitions.name: calculate_scenarios
toolDefinitions.description: Deterministic C# costs and prices. Margins and discount are fractions. Uses stored product/rule, never model-invented costs. Includes undiscounted and discounted scenarios.

toolDefinitions.name: submit_recommendation
toolDefinitions.description: Submit a draft referring only to successful scenario IDs. No prices are applied. Human approval is required.

toolDefinitions.name: request_clarification
toolDefinitions.description: Stop and ask specific questions when essential data/rules/objectives are missing.

data.summary: Comparison draft for headset-stand (demo costs) under demo-direct rule as of 2026-10-24. Target revenue margins 20%, 30%, 40% with 10% discount tested for each target. Undiscounted prices: BRL 38.10 (20%), BRL 44.45 (30%), BRL 53.34 (40%). Discounted charged prices: BRL 34.29, BRL 40.01, BRL 48.01 respectively. Discount reduces realized revenue margin below target in all three cases, while remaining positive.
assumptions: Product and rule are synthetic demonstration data and valid for the stated dates.
All charges in the rule are applied on the same revenue basis used by the calculator: 10% channel rate, 0% tax, 0% advertising, plus BRL 2 fixed fee.
Target margin refers to revenue margin, not markup on production cost.
Discount is applied to the recommended price after pricing to the target margin.
Failure provision includes the synthetic full-print retry assumption embedded in the product costs.
limitations: Costs and rule are demonstration-only and not confirmed business data or a current marketplace fee schedule.
Unmodeled overhead is excluded; contribution is not net profit.
Full-print retry/failure model is assumed as provided in the product fixture.
No marketplace verification or Shopee fee data was used or available.

Discount is applied to the recommended price after pricing to the target margin.
Failure provision includes the synthetic full-print retry assumption embedded in the product costs.
